concepts.name: Keşif Pusulası
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: original symbol-only desktop application logo for Veri_Ufku, a data exploration app. Reinterpret the provided reference concept for our redesigned multicolor dark theme. Produce exactly ONE large centered standalone mark, generous transparent margins, square canvas. Professional clean flat vector-like geometry, confident thick shapes and crisp edges, strong readable silhouette even at 32px. Palette: warm orange #F6A35D, lavender purple #C3A6EF, mint green #91D7B2, turquoise #94C9DF. Use all four intentionally with balanced visual weight; purple and green must be substantial rather than tiny decorative specks. Intended dark backdrop #151722 but the actual image background must be fully transparent. Solid opaque color fills. No text, letters, numbers, captions, mockup, frame, multiple logos, shadows, glow, 3D, gradients, textures, translucent fringes or checkerboard. Input image 1 is a conceptual reference: preserve the distinctive four-point compass ring and internal rising data-point motif, redesign its color arrangement and refine the geometry. Compass directional ring alternates broad orange and lavender sections in a coherent symmetric construction. Inside the open center, a short rising turquoise path with three bold mint/turquoise circular data points. Keep substantial negative space between path and compass, avoid extra compass ticks.

Professional clean flat vector-like geometry, confident thick shapes and crisp edges, strong readable silhouette even at 32px.
